description: HTML Content Viewer lets you render HTML content directly inside your Power BI reports and dashboards. Key features: - Safe HTML rendering with DOMPurify sanitization - Three display modes: HTML, Raw text, and Debug - Support for tables, lists, headings, links, images, and more - Allow external images toggle (off by default for security) - Multiple rows support to combine and render all data rows - Adjustable zoom level, scroll behavior, and padding - Background color and border customization - Sanitization warnings: visual indicators when tags are blocked - Works with both columns and measures containing HTML Use cases: - Render formatted text from your data model - Display HTML emails or content previews - Show rich text generated by DAX measures - Embed formatted tables and styled content Free to use in Power BI Desktop. A license is required for Power BI Service.
